svg.text: Framework Map What Each Framework Does and Where It Fits
COMPLIANCE FRAMEWORKS
NIST AI RMF 1.0 (Govern " Map " Measure " Manage)
US framework for AI risk management. Provides 72 sub-categories.
We use: 12 sub-categories relevant to RAG systems.
EU AI Act (Article 6, 9, 13, 14, 15)
EU regulation. Mandates transparency, accuracy, human oversight.
We use: 5 articles that apply to RAG chatbots (limited/high risk).
ISO 42001 (Annex A controls)
International standard for AI management systems (AIMS).
We use: 10 Annex A controls for data governance + quality.
GAIGI Crosswalk Matrix
Maps equivalent controls across NISTEUISO. Avoids duplication.
We use: As deduplication layer 34 unified controls from 97 raw.
SECURITY FRAMEWORKS
OWASP LLM Top 10 (2025 v2)
10 critical LLM vulnerabilities: injection, data leak, insecure output...
We use: As payload library (all 10 categories with 100+ test vectors).
OWASP RAG Security Cheat Sheet
RAG-specific risks: vector poisoning, context injection, over-retrieval.
We use: 6 RAG-specific test scenarios beyond generic LLM testing.
OWASP LLMSVS v2.0 (Verification Standard)
Structured checklist for verifying LLM application security controls.
We use: As scoring rubric PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL per control.
Garak (AI Red-Teaming Tool)
Open-source LLM security scanner. Generates + runs adversarial probes.
We use: As execution engine. Runs OWASP payloads against target API.
RISK / EVALUATION TOOLS
ContextCheck (Self-Consistency Method)
Detects hallucination without ground truth. Sends same Q 5 times.
We use: Primary hallucination metric (variability = hallucination).
DeepEval (LLM Evaluation Framework)
Metrics: faithfulness, answer relevancy, contextual recall.
We use: NLI-based faithfulness scorer each claim vs citations.
Fairlearn (Microsoft Fairness Toolkit)
Measures demographic parity, equalized odds for AI systems.
We use: Compare RAG responses across 8 demographic query variants.
Microsoft SABER (Statistical Extrapolation)
Models adversarial risk from small sample using Bayesian inference.
We use: Estimate risk at 1000 attacks from 100-sample observation.
ORCHESTRATION & TOOLING How Everything Connects
LangGraph (State Machine Engine)
Controls step execution order, parallel branching, error recovery.
Role: ORCHESTRATOR decides which step runs next, checkpoints state.
checkpoint-ai (Compliance Self-Assessment)
Auto-generates questionnaire from framework requirements.
Role: Translates evidence control pass/fail, flags missing evidence.
Open Policy Agent (OPA)
Policy engine. Defines rules in Rego language, evaluates data.
Role: Evaluates infra configs against compliance rules (policy-as-code).
Cisco AI-BOM / k8s-aibom (Discovery)
Scans repos + K8s deployments produces AI Bill of Materials.
Role: Generates architectural map of all AI components (Tier 2+).
rag-poison-detector + HubScan
Read-only scanner for vector DB. Detects anomalous embeddings.
Role: Identifies potential data poisoning WITHOUT write access.
LLMmap + LLMPrint (Fingerprinting)
Behavioral queries to identify model type + version via API only.
Role: Identifies the LLM model without needing source code (Tier 1).
ORION (NLI-Based Faithfulness)
Uses NLI to verify every claim is grounded in retrieved context.
Role: Measures faithfulness without reference answers (black-box).
Sectum AI / RAGLeakLab
Cross-tenant isolation testing using synthetic tenant provisioning.
Role: Verifies data doesn't leak between tenants (Tier 3 only).
FastAPI + Server-Sent Events (SSE)
HTTP API layer exposing assessment endpoints with streaming.
Role: API server + real-time progress delivery to frontend.
